data.name: Ratiyah
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'r-t-y', meaning 'to be satisfied' or 'contented'. It reflects a sense of inner peace and joy,. It is also said to be a name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and a wife of Ibrahim (Abraham) in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, reflecting a state of contentment and satisfaction with one's life and faith. It is also associated with the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the wife of Ibrahim (Abraham) in Islamic tradition.
data.numerology_meaning: A number of harmony and balance, reflecting the name's spiritual meaning of contentment and satisfaction.
